title: T008 CI pipelines and security gate complete; main read-back passed
summary: T008 CI, Security, Docker Compose health and image vulnerability gates passed on the reviewed implementation head; PR #25 and the completion slice are merged, and authoritative main read-back confirms T008 complete while T009 remains undispatched.

claims.text: T008 frontend contract, Java quality/unit and Docker Compose integration jobs completed successfully.
PostgreSQL, S3Mock and OIDC containers each reported healthy on the GitHub runner.
Dependency audit, CodeQL, filesystem Trivy and all three Compose image Trivy scans completed successfully on reviewed head 15f8317.
The HIGH/CRITICAL image findings were remediated without a security exception; the final security gate passed.
PR #25 merged to main at e857d50, and T008 is checked on the separate completion slice.
Authoritative main read-back at 65f406c confirms T008 checked, T009 unchecked and undispatched.

decision.context: T008 implementation was security-blocked once, remediated, rerun successfully, merged and then verified on main.
decision.chosen: Record T008 as complete on main; keep T009 unchecked and undispatched until a new explicit dispatch authorizes that separate implementation slice.
alternatives: Dispatch T009 immediately without preserving the completed T008 main read-back.
tradeoffs: All required CI/Security gates are green.
The completion and final read-back state are auditable on main.
T009 remains an explicit future implementation boundary.
decision.invalidation: If a later main read-back contradicts the T008 checkbox, evidence lineage or T009 dispatch state, reopen T008 reconciliation before proceeding.
